name: garoutom
description: Garoutom — les loups-garous en ligne, de 6 à 18 joueurs

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @garoutom/engine && npm-run-all --parallel dev:server dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @garoutom/engine && npm run build -w @garoutom/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @garoutom/engine && npm run test -w @garoutom/server && npm run test -w @garoutom/client && npm run test -w @garoutom/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @garoutom/engine && npm run typecheck -w @garoutom/engine && npm run typecheck -w @garoutom/server && npm run typecheck -w @garoutom/client && npm run typecheck -w @garoutom/worker
scripts.worker:dev: npm run build -w @garoutom/engine && npm run dev -w @garoutom/worker
scripts.worker:deploy: npm run build -w @garoutom/engine && npm run deploy -w @garoutom/worker
